title: Repair lifecycle, input, and output integration hazards
runtime_identity: Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, 2 vCPU, Node v22.22.2, Chromium 1194; loopback only
decision_or_code_delta: src/main/spiral/kernel.js: Lifecycle hazards: close settles readers, split UTF-8/escapes, paste hand-off, Ctrl-C cases, close during readline, repeated close.
expected: Pending promises settle, running commands receive cancellation, one exit is emitted, input is not silently lost, and all retained terminal state is quota-bounded.
memory_scope: gateway process (+ worker threads) and worker processes
residual_risks: self-reviewed by the implementer; no independent verification
rollback: delete ram/, gateway/worker-link.js, worker/core.js, worker/thread.js; restore the v1 files from hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (hashes in ledger/ramws_source.json)
linked_tests: parser state persists across arbitrary chunk boundaries (every split point of a mixed stream)
F04 close settles the active reader and emits exactly one exit
Ctrl-C at prompt, during command, and SIGINT signal are distinct and non-fatal
type-ahead: pasted multi-line input executes every line in order
